answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds bind each identity to staking collateral on a trellis of subgame-perfect punishment matrices, where terrace levels of slashing penalties impose escalating expected losses. Zero-knowledge verifiable delay lets a ledger verify honest liveness without revealing keys, while ledge thresholds convert repeated false signatures into irreversible seizure.
